grid_orientation.summary: Graph edge segments[].cell and HAZARD.json member arrays use cell = row*width + col with row 0 at the SOUTH edge (grid.y0) and col 0 at grid.x0. constructed_arrays.npz and the event export FORECAST_<t>.npz are native north-up rasters (row 0 at the north edge, affine [375,0,x0,0,-375,y_top]); native row = height-1-row. HAZARD row_reversal: true denotes exactly this reversal. ForecastCell row/col/cell/id use the south-up graph convention; polygons are the cell's EPSG:5179 square [x0+col*375, y0+row*375] → WGS84.

conventions.times: seconds after input_time (UTC); route times_s absolute, one per vertex

verdict_mapping.anything else: unresolved (TIMEOUT for worker MAX_LABELS/timeout, CHECK_FAILED for end-check rejection, OTHER otherwise)
verdict_mapping.ablation: own_outcome CHECKED_ROUTE + CHECKED_JOURNEY_FULL_OPTIMUM_PROVEN → checked_route; SCOPED_REFUSAL + FULL_MODEL_REFUSAL_PROVEN → model_no_route

conventions.allowed_nodes: at least one incoming and one outgoing road edge (the Route-Check API rule, api/regions.py GraphIndex.load)
conventions.records: full = final panel RDA_CAND repetition 1 (repetition 2 recorded); other policies = ablation repetition 1 (repetition 2 recorded)
